subject: gk
question: Schedule A of the Industrial Policy Resolution 1956 comprised of industries which would be:

options.text: owned by both private and public sector

solution:
The correct answer is __**exclusively owned by the state**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Schedule A of the Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR) 1956 included industries that were to be exclusively owned by the state.
 
• The aim was to ensure state control over industries of basic and strategic importance.
 
• This included sectors like defense, atomic energy, and railway transport.
 
• Heavy industries like iron and steel, heavy machinery, and heavy electrical industries were also included.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Industrial Policy Resolution 1956:**

 
 
• Marked a significant shift towards a socialist model of development.
 
• Classified industries into three schedules - A, B, and C.
 
 
 
• **Schedule B:**
 
 
• Industries where both state and private sectors could operate.
 
• Included industries like machine tools, fertilizers, and road transport.
 
 
 
• **Schedule C:**
 
 
• Industries that were open to the private sector.
 
• However, the state could intervene if deemed necessary.
 
 
 
• **Socialist Model of Development:**
 
 
• A model where the state plays a dominant role in the economic development.
 
• Focuses on equitable distribution of wealth and resources.
